title: Persist setup wizard data
description: Persist wizard choices to the active data adapter. Done 2026-07-16: added ErpSystemDemo.completeSetup({masterName,companyName,country,adminName,adminEmail,language}) -> {masterFn,companyFn,userId} to erp-system-data-adapter.js -- one PGlite transaction that renames the existing master (masterFn stays fixed, single-org demo model), inserts the new company (SG->SGD/GST 9%, MY->MYR/SST 8%; currencies already seeded), an effective-dated tax_rule, a starter chart of accounts (1100/4000/2200) so Finance is not empty, the admin app_user (idempotent on master_fn+email), a Superadmin role (created once), and the user<->company link; rolls back whole on failure. screens-setup-wizard.js Finish now awaits completeSetup() before marking the wizard complete and reloading; a failed write re-enables Finish and toasts the error instead of proceeding. Also added ErpSystemDemo.switchCompany(companyFn) (mutates the module-level SCOPE.companyFn + refresh()) and rewired the topbar company switcher (buildCompanyMenu/wireCompanyMenu in app.js), which previously read a completely disconnected Aria mock array (DB.masters[0].companies, a no-op toast-only 'switch') -- it now reads DB.erpSystem.companies (canonical, includes wizard-created companies) and performs a real scope switch + screen refresh. Found and fixed a real crash risk while implementing: applyData() dereferenced d.customers[0] (var beta) unguarded in ~10 display-string spots; a wizard-created company legitimately has zero customers, which would throw. Added a stub fallback ({name:'No customers yet',...}); verified beta is never used as a query key, only for display, so the stub is safe everywhere. Also fixed DB.company.branch being hardcoded 'Singapore HQ' regardless of country (now derives 'Kuala Lumpur HQ' for MY). Verified end-to-end in browser: created a second Malaysia company via the wizard, confirmed the write (queried PGlite directly), switched to it from the topbar (zero console errors, correctly empty RM0.00 dashboard, no crash), switched back to Acme Singapore (data intact, S$119.90 AR unchanged), spot-checked General Ledger for regressions. typecheck/typecheck:web/npm run demo/build:demo all pass.

title: Wire VITE_DATA_MODE seam into frontend data adapter
description: The documented VITE_DATA_MODE=demo|api switch is not referenced anywhere in web/public/assets/ — erp-system-data-adapter.js unconditionally boots PGlite. Introduce a small build-time injection (vite define or a generated config.js) exposing the mode, split the adapter into a common interface with a demo (PGlite, current behavior) implementation and an api (HTTP) implementation whose endpoints may 501-stub until TASK-011 lands. Demo behavior must not regress. Done 2026-07-16: web/index.html's first script tag sets window.__ERP_DATA_MODE__ from Vite's built-in %VITE_DATA_MODE% HTML placeholder (substituted at build time from the env var; verified empirically that an unset env var leaves the literal unreplaced string, not empty -- window.erpDataMode() treats anything other than exactly 'api' as 'demo', so demo/dev/build stay unaffected with zero script changes needed) and defines window.erpDataMode(). erp-system-data-adapter.js (demo/PGlite, unchanged behavior) gained one guard line that self-disables when mode!=='demo'. New web/public/assets/erp-system-api-adapter.js self-disables when mode!=='api'; otherwise does a real health check (GET {base}/health, requires an actual JSON body -- res.ok alone is not enough, vite preview's SPA fallback returns 200+index.html for any unmatched path including /health when no real API exists, which looked falsely 'reachable' until this check was tightened) and exposes the SAME window.ErpSystemDemo shape (ready/reset/refresh/confirmOrder/completeSetup/switchCompany/mode/db) as the demo adapter -- this is the documented contract TASK-011's server must satisfy. Every write rejects with a clear 'not available yet, see TASK-011' error rather than silently no-op'ing. New renderApiUnavailable() in app.js (boot() gate, checked first, before the wizard/login gates) shows an honest 'Waiting for the API' full-screen state with a Retry button instead of fabricating fake dashboard data when api mode can't reach a server -- deliberately does NOT reuse the rich PGlite->DB.* payload mapper (extracting that ~300-line applyData() into a shared file is left for TASK-011, when there is a real payload shape to map from). Verified in browser: VITE_DATA_MODE=demo build unchanged (console still logs the PGlite boot path, wizard/login/dashboard flow identical, zero regressions); VITE_DATA_MODE=api build shows the honest waiting screen with zero console errors at desktop and 375px, Retry reloads correctly. typecheck/typecheck:web/npm run demo/build:demo all pass; both api-mode and demo-mode vite builds verified to substitute the placeholder correctly.
acceptance: Frontend reads the build-time data mode and logs the active adapter on boot
VITE_DATA_MODE=demo build behaves exactly as today (PGlite + static fallback)
VITE_DATA_MODE=api build routes reads/writes through the HTTP adapter interface
npm run build:demo and npm run build both pass
